name: TMS Action 14
definition: Single terminal management action to be performed by the point of interaction.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Types of action to be performed by a point of interaction (POI).

Key.name: Key
Key.definition: Cryptographic key used to communicate with the host.

TerminalManagerIdentification.name: Terminal Manager Identification
TerminalManagerIdentification.definition: Identification of the master terminal manager or the terminal manager with which the POI has to perform the action.

TMSProtocol.name: TMS Protocol
TMSProtocol.definition: TMS protocol to use for performing the maintenance action.

TMSProtocolVersion.name: TMS Protocol Version
TMSProtocolVersion.definition: Version of the TMS protocol to use to perform the maintenance action.

DataSetIdentification.name: Data Set Identification
DataSetIdentification.definition: Data set on which the action has to be performed.

ComponentType.name: Component Type
ComponentType.definition: Type of POI components to send in a status report.

DelegationScopeIdentification.name: Delegation Scope Identification
DelegationScopeIdentification.definition: Identifies the delegation scope assigned by the MTM.

DelegationScopeDefinition.name: Delegation Scope Definition
DelegationScopeDefinition.definition: This element contains all information relevant to the DelegationScopeIdentification. The format of this element is out of scope of this definition.

DelegationProof.name: Delegation Proof
DelegationProof.definition: Contains the necessary information to secure the management of the Delegation. The format of this element is out of scope of this definition.

Trigger.name: Trigger
Trigger.definition: Event on which the action has to be activated by the point of interaction (POI).

AdditionalProcess.name: Additional Process
AdditionalProcess.definition: Additional process to perform before starting or after completing the action by the point of interaction (POI).

ReTry.name: Re Try
ReTry.definition: Definition of retry process if activation of the action fails.

TimeCondition.name: Time Condition
TimeCondition.definition: Date and time the action has to be performed.

TMChallenge.name: TM Challenge
TMChallenge.definition: Terminal manager challenge for cryptographic key injection.

KeyEnciphermentCertificate.name: Key Encipherment Certificate
KeyEnciphermentCertificate.definition: Certificate chain for the encryption of temporary transport key of the key to inject.

ErrorAction.name: Error Action
ErrorAction.definition: Action to perform in case of error on the related action in progress.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information about the maintenance action.

DeviceRequest.name: Device Request
DeviceRequest.definition: Information related to a device request of the POI.
